newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nov crude palm oil output down 13.83 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nov crude palm oil output down 13.83 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 13.83 percent to 762,540 tonnes in November from 884,887 in October and against 743,251 tonnes in November 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Monday.
November palm oil exports were 632,441 tonnes against 728,393 in October and 546,914 in November last year, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 13.84 percent to 561,714 tonnes in November from 651,934 in October and 572,725 tonnes in November 1995.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak fell 13.79 percent to 200,826 tonnes in November from 232,953 tonnes in October and against 170,526 tonnes in November 1995.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production fell 3.28 percent to 104,117 tonnes in November from 107,646 in October and against 92,454 tonnes in November last year.
